questions.question: What does the synchronized warmed timer in this lesson measure?
options: Only the accelerator kernel, with all dispatch overhead removed
A warmed call including dispatch and waiting for output readiness, excluding prior input placement
questions.explanation: The boundary includes the call and its completion wait. It excludes input placement and does not isolate compiler or kernel stages.
optionFeedback: The measured boundary includes host dispatch and the wait. Calling it pure device-kernel time requires a device trace.
